svg.title: Atramenth: the Qur’ān in English, read closely.
svg.desc: Animated Atramenth banner. A ring of 114 sūrahs on two tracks draws itself around a slow scan line, beside the line The Qur’ān in English, read closely, and four facts: translated by Tahereh Saffarzadeh, 30 parts, 1,196 pages, light and dark themes.
